i2c.note: ADDR 引脚四态（§7.5）；8 位指针寄存器复位 00（§7.5.2），MVP 不断言指针本身

registers.name: TEMP
registers.desc: 温度结果（§7.6.2 Table 7-5）。16 位只读、补码、1 LSB=7.8125 m°C；**复位后读 8000h（= −256°C）直至首次转换完成**——本基准少见的非零 RO 复位值

fields.name: T
fields.desc: T[15:0]（复位值按整寄存器 8000h 断言，字段级不设 read_as）

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.desc: Factory CONFIG0220h with EEPROM-backed mask07FC; MOD1 is nonpersistent. HIGH/LOW read clear only in Alert mode T/nA0; Therm mode has threshold/hysteresis HIGH and LOW0, CONFIG read does not clear alert flags. DATA_READY clears on CONFIG or TEMP reads; Busy mirrors unlock Busy and is temporal. Soft_Reset Figure/table access conflict retained.

fields.name: HIGH_ALERT
fields.desc: R, reset 0. In Alert mode (T/nA=0), read CONFIG clears HIGH_Alert; in Therm mode (T/nA=1), CONFIG read does not clear, temperature conversion > high limit sets and < low limit clears. Dynamic event model required.

fields.name: LOW_ALERT
fields.desc: R, reset 0. In Alert mode (T/nA=0), read CONFIG clears LOW_Alert; in Therm mode (T/nA=1), always reads 0. No unconditional read-clear annotation.

fields.name: DATA_READY
fields.desc: 转换完成标志，R；**读 TEMP 或 CONFIG 都会清除**

fields.name: EEPROM_BUSY
fields.desc: R status, mirror of EEPROM_UL[14]. Busy=1 while POR EEPROM loading or programming;0 means ready. POR loading approximately1.5ms; programming a cell typically7ms. Reads do not clear Busy; wait Busy=0 before next programming write.

fields.name: MOD
fields.desc: MOD codes00 continuous,01 shutdown,10 continuous with readback00,11 one-shot; p.27 Table7-6

fields.name: CONV
fields.desc: CONV codes 000..111 all defined. Table7-7 continuous cycle time depends on AVG: default CONV=100 gives 1s for all AVG settings; 101/110/111 give4/8/16s. One-shot duration depends on AVG and is independent of CONV.

fields.name: AVG
fields.desc: AVG codes0/1/2/3 = no averaging/8/32/64 conversions; p.27 Table7-6

fields.name: TNA
fields.desc: 0=Alert 模式 1=Thermometer 模式

fields.name: POL
fields.desc: ALERT/DRDY 极性

fields.name: DR_ALERT
fields.desc: 引脚功能选择 DRDY vs Alert

fields.name: SOFT_RESET
fields.desc: Same-file unresolved source conflict: Figure7-14 bit1 is R0, Table7-6 continued is R/W0 and says write1 triggers2ms software reset and always reads0. Any table-text-priority action profile is explicitly conditional; no official erratum established.

fields.name: UNUSED
fields.desc: 未用，R-0
fields.tier_evidence: 位标注在 Figure 里（文本层无 R-0b 命中）；这颗本身就是图/表矛盾的那颗（Soft_Reset 位）

registers.name: THIGH
registers.desc: 高温门限（§7.6.4 Figure 7-15，16 位全 R/W，出厂 6000h 来自 EEPROM）

registers.name: TLOW
registers.desc: 低温门限（§7.6.5，出厂 8000h 来自 EEPROM）

registers.name: EEPROM_UL
registers.desc: EEPROM unlock: EUN[15] R/W0; Busy[14] R0 and mirror CONFIG[12]; Reserved[13:0] R0. Locked writes to EEPROM addresses still update volatile digital registers; EUN1 permits NVM programming when Busy0. Programming typical7ms, no writes until Busy0.

fields.name: EUN
fields.desc: EUN0: writes to EEPROM mapped addresses update volatile digital registers but do not program EEPROM. EUN1: writes to programmable registers program backing EEPROM only when ready. Wait Busy0 before further writes; general-call reset clears EUN and reloads EEPROM.

fields.name: EEPROM_BUSY
fields.desc: R status, mirror of CONFIG[12]. Busy=1 while POR reset load or programming;0 means ready. Not a read-clear field. Reset0 applies after POR load complete.

fields.name: UNUSED
fields.desc: R-0 全 14 位保留
fields.tier_evidence: 位标注在 Figure 里（文本层无 R-0b 命中）；这颗本身就是图/表矛盾的那颗（Soft_Reset 位）

registers.name: EEPROM1
registers.desc: 16-bit R/W volatile scratch register backed by programmable EEPROM. Locked(EUN0) writes update volatile register and are readable but do not burn EEPROM; unlocked(EUN1) writes program backing memory. Reset loads persistent manufacturing/user contents, numerical value unknown. No writes during Busy. EEPROM2 additionally has conflicting reset0000 title vs detailedxxxx/diagramR/W-x, retained unresolved.

registers.name: EEPROM2
registers.desc: 16-bit R/W volatile scratch register backed by programmable EEPROM. Locked(EUN0) writes update volatile register and are readable but do not burn EEPROM; unlocked(EUN1) writes program backing memory. Reset loads persistent manufacturing/user contents, numerical value unknown. No writes during Busy. EEPROM2 additionally has conflicting reset0000 title vs detailedxxxx/diagramR/W-x, retained unresolved.

fields.name: OFF
fields.desc: 16-bit signed temperature offset; saturates result at temperature output range limits. Factory reset0 is EEPROM-backed per Table7-3 note1, so programmed EEPROM can change its reset.

registers.name: EEPROM3
registers.desc: 16-bit R/W volatile scratch register backed by programmable EEPROM. Locked(EUN0) writes update volatile register and are readable but do not burn EEPROM; unlocked(EUN1) writes program backing memory. Reset loads persistent manufacturing/user contents, numerical value unknown. No writes during Busy. EEPROM2 additionally has conflicting reset0000 title vs detailedxxxx/diagramR/W-x, retained unresolved.

registers.name: DEVICE_ID
registers.desc: RO device ID register: low12 DID117h known; upper4 revision bits unresolved R-x/0h source conflict. Full0117h is conditional revision0 profile, not an unconditional cross-revision reset value.

fields.name: ID
fields.desc: RO aggregate ID contains revision[15:12] and DID[11:0]. DID117h is consistent; revision reset is Figure7-22 R-x versus Table7-15 0h. Main comparison mask0FFF across reset/snapshots; retain source conflict.

excluded_blocks: I2C general-call reset（§7.5.3.x 提到用 general call 命令触发软件复位）属总线行为，不在寄存器堆黑盒接口内
EEPROM 编程时序（2ms busy、需 EUN 解锁）不建模，见 open_questions Q1/Q3
